doc.title: Dan Wall and Adam Nussbaum interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001

title: Wrapping up and who they would love to have played with
summary: Rowe notes the sound check and asks about people they have not played with.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Well I know you fellas have to get to a sound check.
Yeah but we could probably go on —
Do you have any other pertinent questions?
Well let me think about that for a moment. Do you have like a list, a short list of people that you haven’t played with yet that you’d just love to? Or maybe even people have passed on that —
